title: Rename the product to Cubric Studio - repo, app, mascots, sites
description: Child of MPI-677. The family merged into one app, so the ecosystem name is free: Cubric Vision becomes Cubric Studio at 2.0. 1.5 is the last release under the old name. Five workstreams across three repos - GitHub repo renames (hub to Cubric-Connector FIRST to free the name, then Cubric-Vision to Cubric-Studio), in-app name + userData migration, mascots and per-op colours, MadPony-Identity sites and socials, the 2.0 release note. Full reasoning and ordering: brief.md.
